environment.methodology: Serial CLI sessions over pipes; parent monotonic wall clock. Startup: spawn to complete first board, 3 discarded launches per target, rotated target order. Idle RSS: ps after first board in 5 separate launches after startup timing. Search: first hint in fresh session, then repeated hints in that session with cleared engine search table; first repeat discarded except L10. L10: first search plus 2 repeats. Peak RSS: macOS /usr/bin/time -l across each entire search session. These are warm-filesystem process starts, not cold boot starts. All search result frames must match across runtimes and repeats. Local move: play e2e4 from a reset board, including validation and render, 3 discarded then 25 measured (5 in quick mode). No console output inside timed regions.

caveats: Background host load was high; one observed load-average sample was 30.58/26.94/20.52 on 10 logical CPUs. Wall times are descriptive, not precise speedup estimates.
App L10 has only two measured repeats; ScriptC ranged 14.17–23.68 seconds.
ScriptC app omits stdout error-listener registration. Headless engine is unchanged on every runtime.
Native normalized sizes use strip then ad-hoc codesign; tiny programs can grow due to signature alignment.
Symbol extents are address-delta upper bounds with aliases counted once; zero-fill sections excluded from file bytes. Retained code does not prove it can all be removed.
